layout.headline: Real work, real businesses.
Everything you wanted to ask.

items.question: What if I don't like the design?
items.answer: You see a Figma mockup before any code is written. If the mockup is not right, we iterate until it is. The build clock does not start until you approve the direction.

items.question: Do I own the code?
items.answer: Yes. The code lives in a GitHub repo we hand over on launch. No lock-in — though most clients keep us as their host because it is already optimized.

items.question: Can you work with my existing brand?
items.answer: Yes. If you have a logo, colors, and fonts, we use them. If not, we recommend a small design system as a $300 add-on.

items.question: What's the next step?
items.answer: Send a note via the form, or book a call. We reply within one business day and send a written proposal within 48 hours of the intro call.
